gaps.lead: We wanted to continue our mountain trek but the weather was too bad.
gaps.sentence: We ___ on with our mountain trek but the weather was too bad.
gaps.hint: unfulfilled wish: would have liked to
gaps.explanation: An unrealised wish about the past: 'would have liked to carry on'.

gaps.lead: She started working here five years ago.
gaps.explanation: Action continuing from a past point to now: has been working (present perfect continuous).

gaps.lead: I have never heard such a ridiculous excuse.
gaps.explanation: Fronted 'never' forces inversion: Never have I heard…

gaps.lead: He spoke slowly because he wanted us to understand him.
gaps.explanation: so that + subject + would/could expresses purpose.

gaps.lead: Nobody can say that he doesn't work hard.
'We are closing the factory,' the board announced.
gaps.sentence: The board announced that ___ the factory.
gaps.explanation: we → they; present continuous → past continuous: they were closing.
